_comment: Stage 2b anchor reconstruction: GPT-2 124M FineWebEdu baseline on prune's W7900, trusted architecture (12L/12H/768d, block 1024, bias true, dropout 0.1, vocab 50304, weight tying) and the exact bins the December 2025 ablation used. DEVIATION, recorded: optimizer is plain AdamW (0.9,0.95) wd 0.1 rather than the trusted AdamWSPAM, and this is single-GPU without DDP/HYPER_PARAM_AUTO. The checkpoint is a measurement platform for the spectral audit, not a reproduction of the trusted run. ~20k steps x 8x1024 tokens = ~164M tokens; checkpoints every 2000 steps so the audit can track spectrum stability across training time.
